description_en: Gets a list of PAIRec instances
kebab_example: aliyun pairecservice list-instances --instance-id pairec-test1 --sort-by Type --order Desc --page-number 1 --page-size 50 --type basic --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListInstances

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance. You can use this parameter to perform a fuzzy search for instances
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The field by which to sort the results
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en: The sort order. Valid values: `Asc` (ascending) and `Desc` (descending)
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The instance type. Valid values:

- `basic`: Basic edition

- `high-level`: High-level edition

- `advanced`: Advanced edition

- `standard`: Standard edition
parameters.help_zh:

- basic-基础版
- highleve-升级版
- advance-进阶版
- standard-标准版
parameters.name: type
